answers.core: Default Godot settings provide this type of variables already, I think this should be extended to custom settings as part of the core functionality ;)
answers.workaround: In GDScript: I don't think so, this is Project Settings level. However, I believe that reusing the code from default Project Settings should not be difficult, as it already works for some default settings (e.g. for "Main Scene"). It would just be a matter of enabling that setting type (more precisely: String type with a proper hint) to custom settings.

title: Introduce new type of custom project setting: file path
